name: Grafana
description: Let agents find and read Grafana dashboards and alert rules, and read alert state changes and annotations around an incident. For first response to production alerts.
identity: A Grafana service account token. The service account has the Viewer role, so it reads what a viewer in your organization may read.

setup.title: Create a service account with the Viewer role
setup.body: You need a Grafana organization administrator for this. Viewer lets agents read dashboards, alert rules and annotations and change nothing.
click: In Grafana, select Administration > Users and access > Service accounts > Add service account.
Display name: AI agents. Select Create.
On the AI agents service account, set its role to Viewer with the role picker.

setup.title: Add a token
setup.body: Grafana shows the token only once. You can test it with the command below: it shows your organization's name and changes nothing.
click: On the AI agents service account, select Add service account token.
Name: AI agents. Set an expiration date, then select Generate token and copy it.

fields.label: Grafana address
fields.help: The host name of your Grafana, such as grafana.example.com or yourstack.grafana.net, without https://.

capabilities.label: Read dashboards and alert rules
capabilities.description: Search dashboards and folders, read a dashboard's panels and queries, and list and read alert rules.
capabilities.note: Read-only. Reaches every dashboard and alert rule a viewer can see unless you keep a key to chosen folders. Reading alert rules with the Viewer role needs Grafana 11 or later.

capabilities.label: Read annotations
capabilities.description: Read annotations in a time window, such as alert state changes, deployments and notes people added to graphs.
capabilities.note: Annotations are read across the organization, whatever folders a key is kept to.

limits.label: Folders
limits.help: Optional: only dashboards and alert rules in these folders, by folder UID (in the folder's address after /dashboards/f/). Leave empty for every folder.

revoke: In Grafana, go to Administration > Users and access > Service accounts, select AI agents and delete its token, or the service account. Agents lose access to Grafana at once.

tools.name: grafana_search
tools.description: Search dashboards or folders by title, tag or folder. Pass page to read further pages, from 1.

tag.description: Only those with all these tags

folder_uids.description: Only in these folders, by UID
folder_uids.name: folderUIDs

tools.name: grafana_get_dashboard
tools.description: Read a dashboard by UID: its panels with their titles, queries and data sources, its variables and its folder.

tools.name: grafana_list_alert_rules
tools.description: List every alert rule with its folder, group, condition and labels. Under a key kept to some folders, this answers only when every rule is in them; read one rule instead.

tools.name: grafana_get_alert_rule
tools.description: Read one alert rule by UID: its queries, condition, labels, annotations such as the runbook, and how long it must hold before firing.

tools.name: grafana_list_annotations
tools.description: List annotations in a time window, newest first: alert state changes (type alert) or notes people added (type annotation), optionally on one dashboard or with tags.

from.description: Start of the window, milliseconds since 1970

to.description: End of the window, milliseconds since 1970

tags.description: Only those with all these tags
